chapter: University of Chicago and the Cakewalking Babies
title: Bill Price, band members' fates, Don Ewell sitting in
summary: They discuss Bill Price's later life, lost track of other members, and Don Ewell sitting in and possible lost recordings.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Well, I think Bill Price did. Bill Price was very much influenced by Louis and Bunk and possibly some of the others like George Mitchell.

G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Bill Price now lives in Minneapolis, but frequently comes to Chicago and he hears about a jam session where he might sit in. So he comes down sometimes for a Sunday session where there is advertised there will be ten bands. Well, he knows that if he comes down there enough people know him that he'd get in one of those bands. So he's on and on for a set or two. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. And I understand that he works occasionally in Minneapolis, becoming a friend of Doc Evans and other...

G-E-R-O-U-L-D. I saw Bill a few months ago in New York at a benefit at the Central Plaza for Jack Crystal. In fact, I saw just about everybody in the world there. It's one of those things everybody turned up.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Did he go to New York for that or happened to be in New York?
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, he just happened to be in New York in business or something. I don't... I've forgotten.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Have you heard about any of the other people besides Bill from your cakewalking babies
continuing their interest in... G-E-R-O-U-L-D. No, I have no idea what's happened to any of the others.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. You say that Art Hody sat in with you. If I remember, Don Ewell used to occasionally.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yeah, Don used to play with us quite often. In fact, I think we may have made some records which have become lost.
